response.sql: WITH pattern_averages AS (SELECT `ANA Pattern` AS pattern, AVG(`aCL IgG`) AS average_igg FROM Examination WHERE `ANA Pattern` IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(`ANA Pattern`) <> '' GROUP BY `ANA Pattern`), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(average_igg) AS mean_average FROM pattern_averages), kept AS (SELECT p.* FROM pattern_averages p CROSS JOIN overall_mean o WHERE p.average_igg > o.mean_average), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(average_igg) AS mean_average FROM kept) SELECT k.pattern, k.average_igg, k.average_igg - o.mean_average AS above_overall_mean, ABS(k.average_igg - m.mean_average) AS distance_from_kept_mean FROM kept k CROSS JOIN overall_mean o CROSS JOIN kept_mean m ORDER BY k.pattern

assumptions.assumption: A NULL, empty, or whitespace-only ANA Pattern is unrecorded; distance from the kept mean is absolute.

alternatives.interpretation: If 'how far it is from' means a signed deviation, use the average minus the kept mean.
